         **Review-Beispiele:**

My first complaint was that Ai had to down grade from black card to basic membership when I was having fiscal difficulties. Staff helped me make the change, but then it automatically reset to black card membership without my approval. I cannot go to the site any longer and looked up how to cancel a subscription at the portal ( was told I could) well- you cannot. So now I’m going down the rabbit hole trying to figure out how to cancel this some other way with no help other than to go in person- which I cannot."
